title: Aeronautics Act (R.S.C., 1985, c. A-2)
use: Statutory basis underlying the CARs; general legal-framework questions.
notes: Primary legal source. The CARs (SOR/96-433) are made under this Act.

title: Canadian Aviation Regulations (SOR/96-433)
use: Authoritative CARs Part IX wording, section verification, and quiz validation
notes: Primary legal source. Prefer over secondary explanatory material when resolving conflicts. Use sectionUrlTemplate with a section number (e.g. 901.27) to deep-link directly to that section on the Justice Laws full-text page. Full local PDF/XML gold-source copies are in docs/ for offline section verification.

title: Canadian Aviation Regulations index
use: Locate CARs Part IX sections and regulatory ranges
notes: Preferred navigation entry point; use Justice Laws for authoritative wording.

title: TC AIM 2026-1 — RPA chapter
use: Operational explanation and context for CARs Part IX

title: Drone Pilot Study Resources
use: Master index to Transport Canada-recommended RPAS study resources
notes: Includes links to TP 15263, TP 15530, Human Factors, ROC-A, NAV CANADA publications, and more.

title: RPAS 101
use: General Canadian RPAS knowledge and study support
notes: Use current CARs/TC/NAV CANADA material to resolve any conflict.

title: Knowledge Requirements for Pilots of RPAS, 250 g up to and including 150 kg — Basic and Advanced Operations (TP 15263)
use: Defines exact knowledge areas/objectives examined for Basic and Advanced Operations exams; use to structure and scope quiz categories.
notes: Gold source for aligning question categories/difficulty to actual exam content.

title: Knowledge Requirements for Pilots of RPAS — Level 1 Complex Operations (TP 15530)
use: Defines knowledge areas for Level 1 Complex (BVLOS) operations exam; relevant for advanced/complex-tier tricky questions (C2 links, DAA, GNSS, RPOC).
notes: Requires the Advanced exam as a prerequisite; use for stretch/complex questions beyond core Advanced scope.

title: Transport Canada Aeronautical Information Manual (TC AIM) (TP 14371)
use: Full AIM (GEN, AGA, COM, MET, RAC, AIR, SAR, RPA and other chapters); RPA chapter already held locally, other chapters available for airspace/navigation/weather categories.
notes: Chapter PDFs are split by section (e.g. aim-2026-1_rac_en.pdf for rules of the air, aim-2026-1_met_en.pdf for weather). Only the RPA chapter has been downloaded locally so far.

title: Human Factors for Aviation — Basic Handbook (TP 12863)
use: Source material for human-factors/crew-fitness quiz category.
notes: Not freely downloadable: TC's Air Publications - Abstracts page lists this as "available to order" only, routing to the TC Publications Order Desk (phone/email/mail, priced/print-on-demand). No confirmed free public PDF as of 2026-09-06.

title: Human Factors for Aviation — Advanced Handbook (TP 12864)
use: Deeper source material for human-factors category, including CRM and hazardous attitudes.
notes: Not freely downloadable: TC's Air Publications - Abstracts page lists this as "available to order" only, routing to the TC Publications Order Desk (phone/email/mail, priced/print-on-demand). No confirmed free public PDF as of 2026-09-06.

title: RIC-21 — Study Guide for the Restricted Operator Certificate with Aeronautical Qualification (ROC-A)
organization: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada (ISED)
use: Source for radio/phraseology/licensing category; required if RPAS operations involve radio communications.
notes: No direct free PDF confirmed; available through ISED district offices per TC's published study-resource list. URL should be re-verified as ISED has reorganized pages in the past.

title: NAV CANADA Aeronautical Information Products (VNC, VTA, CFS, CWAS)
use: Source for navigation/chart-reading questions (VNC/VTA symbology, CFS aerodrome data).
notes: General catalogue/purchase page for the paid chart products (VNC/VTA/CFS/CWAS) — no local copy held. The Designated Airspace Handbook is NOT a paid product and now has its own entry (ref-navcanada-dah) with a free current-issue PDF.

title: Designated Airspace Handbook (DAH) — current issue
use: Authoritative boundaries, altitudes, times of use and controlling/using agency for every named Class F Restricted (CYR), Advisory (CYA) and Danger (CYD) area — the actual document CARs 601.02/601.04/900.07 point to.
notes: Free current-issue PDF, effective 2026-07-09 (posted until its next expiry; the 'next issue' link on the operational-guides page updates automatically — re-check periodically and re-download, since this localCopy will go stale). A derived lookup index (241 area codes → page number/snippet) was extracted to docs/DAH_area_index.json to speed up finding a specific CYR/CYA/CYD entry without re-scanning the full 216-page PDF.

title: NAV CANADA VFR Phraseology Guide
notes: Freely downloadable; local copy held in docs/.

title: Advisory Circular AC 107-002 — Safety Management System Development Guide for Smaller Aviation Organizations
use: Source for SMS/safety-culture concepts referenced across human-factors, maintenance, abnormal and safety quiz categories.
notes: Fully free/publicly hosted HTML + direct PDF download, no order required. Appendix J explicitly defines/uses ALARP ("as low as reasonably practical") in its risk-acceptability guidance, confirming this as the correct source for ALARP quiz questions.

title: Advisory Circular AC 903-001 — Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems Operational Risk Assessment
use: Source for operational risk assessment concepts referenced in the safety quiz category.
notes: Listed under the 900-series advisory circulars page; no standalone URL confirmed.
